short_description: Flagship unlocked 14th-Gen Core i9 CPU with 24 cores, 32 threads & up to 6 GHz boost.
key_features: • Hybrid P-core/E-core design • PCIe 5.0 • DDR4/DDR5 support • Integrated UHD 770 • Unlocked
long_description: The Intel Core i9-14900K is Intel’s top desktop CPU in the 14th Gen “Raptor Lake Refresh” lineup. With 8 high-performance cores and 16 efficient cores (24 cores total and 32 threads), it excels at both single-threaded and heavy multi-threaded workloads, from gaming to content creation and productivity tasks. It supports both current high-speed DDR5 memory and legacy DDR4, plus modern PCIe 5.0 connectivity. Running on the LGA1700 platform, it requires robust cooling and a quality power delivery platform for maximum performance.

short_description: 8-core Zen 4 desktop CPU with massive 96 MB 3D V-Cache optimized for gaming performance.
key_features: • AMD 3D V-Cache tech for extra L3 cache • AM5 socket · DDR5 • PCIe 5.0 • Radeon Graphics • Unlocked
long_description: The AMD Ryzen 7 7800X3D is a high-performance gaming-focused desktop processor based on Zen 4 architecture with AMD 3D V-Cache technology. It features 8 physical cores and 16 threads, with a large 96 MB L3 cache that significantly boosts gaming performance and latency. Built for the AM5 platform, it supports DDR5 memory and PCIe 5.0 connectivity, making it future-ready. Unlike standard Ryzen CPUs, the massive 3D-stacked L3 cache dramatically improves game frame rates and responsiveness, while still providing solid productivity capabilities. Best paired with quality cooling and a mid-to-high-end AM5 motherboard chipset like X670 or B650.

short_description: Balanced 14-core mid-range desktop CPU with strong gaming & productivity performance.
key_features: • Hybrid P/E core design • Unlocked for overclocking • DDR5 & DDR4 support • PCIe 5.0 • Integrated UHD 770
long_description: he Intel Core i5-13600K is a 13th-generation Raptor Lake desktop processor built on the Intel 7 process featuring a hybrid architecture of 6 high-performance cores and 8 efficient cores (14 cores, 20 threads). With base power of 125 W and turbo up to ~181 W, it supports both DDR5-5600 and DDR4-3200 memory and PCIe 5.0 lanes, offering excellent performance for gaming, productivity, and multitasking at a strong price-to-performance point. The integrated Intel UHD Graphics 770 enables basic display output without a discrete GPU. Its unlocked multiplier allows overclocking when paired with appropriate cooling.

short_description: 6-core Zen 4 AM5 desktop CPU with Radeon integrated graphics.
key_features: • 6 cores / 12 threads • DDR5 support • PCIe 5.0 • Radeon Graphics • Efficient 65 W design
long_description: The AMD Ryzen 5 7600 is a mid-range desktop processor built on the Zen 4 architecture with 6 cores and 12 threads, offering 3.8 GHz base and up to 5.1 GHz boost clocks for strong single- and multi-threaded performance. It supports modern DDR5-5200 memory and PCIe 5.0 lanes, and integrates Radeon graphics, making it versatile for both gaming and productivity without needing a discrete GPU. Its 65 W TDP and bundled Wraith Stealth cooler provide good efficiency and out-of-box cooling, while the unlocked multiplier allows overclocking with capable cooling and an AM5 motherboard platform.

short_description: High-performance 14th Gen Intel desktop CPU with 20 cores, 28 threads & integrated graphics.
key_features: • Hybrid architecture (P + E cores) • Unlocked for overclocking • Supports PCIe 5.0 • DDR4/DDR5
long_description: The Core i7-14700K is a flagship mid/upper-tier desktop processor in Intel’s 14th-gen Raptor Lake Refresh lineup. It combines 8 high-performance cores and 12 efficient cores for strong multi-threaded and single-threaded performance, making it ideal for gaming, content creation, and productivity. The CPU supports both DDR5 and DDR4 memory (depending on motherboard), PCIe 5.0 connectivity, and is unlocked for overclocking. With integrated UHD Graphics 770, it also offers basic GPU support if discrete graphics are not installed.
